title: 克烈·斯嘎尔点心站
description: 白胡子克烈坐在小凳上给斯嘎尔递胡萝卜，坐骑乖巧趴着，武器全部静置。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Kled is a small wiry adult yordle with shaggy pale fur, a huge white moustache, expressive eyebrows, a battered military-style cap, and patchwork red-brown clothing. Preserve his fully covered coat, trousers, gloves, boots, and his friendly lizard mount Skaarl with a long beaklike snout. His firearm and long polearm stay secured in closed saddle supports, completely inactive.
art_direction.scene: He sits on a little camp stool beside a resting Skaarl and offers a small carrot from an open snack basket. Skaarl lies comfortably with folded legs, watching the food with a wide curious eye. A plain fence and one rolled blanket suggest a quiet stop, and neither character looks angry or ready to charge.
art_direction.palette: cream fur, faded red, lizard teal, carrot orange
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
